scope: Compare saved Wan M0 decoded-frame count, latent temporal axis, VAE compression metadata, and the planned DiTraj RGB-frame anchors.
model_outcome_claim: none; no model inference or chunked-generation comparison

temporal_alignment.interpretation_limit: These are nominal stride anchors, not disjoint RGB-frame groups or a measurement of each latent's exact temporal receptive field.

saved_temporal_diagnostics.transformer_summary_semantics: selected block outputs pooled over spatial tokens per latent frame; positive and negative prompt calls kept separate

recommendation.framewise_view: Keep all decoded RGB frames as the evaluation/readout unit for visibility, identity, box, and trajectory measurements.
recommendation.latent_view: Index internal-state measurements by latent time position and denoising step; this run has five latent positions, not seventeen.
recommendation.chunking: Do not make chunked generation a fixed architecture requirement. Consider it only after a measured memory, latency, or control-horizon constraint; compare against the full-sequence baseline because chunking changes temporal context.

limitations: Metadata only; no model was loaded and no GPU was used.
The audit does not determine exact VAE receptive-field support per latent position.
No equivalence or quality comparison between full-sequence and chunked inference was run.
